action.onPreview: parra set --no-save '{{ path }}'; change-colortheme -c '{{ colorHex }}' noctalia niri hyprland
action.onRestore: parra restore; change-colortheme -c '{{ flavor }}' noctalia niri hyprland

saveState.command: jq -r ".$(noctalia msg theme-mode-get).mPrimary // empty" "$HOME/.config/noctalia/palettes/$(noctalia msg color-scheme-get | cut -d' ' -f2-).json"
